artifacts.summary: 6-phase linear plan: new whole-tree ignore block renderer, init-specs.sh fresh-repo detection writing a root-level managed /specs/ block, posture-aware Check C, both-posture test coverage, standards-file posture split with manual opt-in runbook, and a redeploy phase whose negative control asserts the reference repository's tracked specs tree is untouched against the git index.

memory_candidates.content: Introducing a second legitimate POSTURE for a repository-level invariant (here: a whole specs/ tree gitignored by default versus tracked) silently invalidates every unconditional 'must never be X' assertion elsewhere in the system, plus the test fixtures that assert the old single-posture outcome. At plan time this is cheap to find and expensive to miss: grep the verification scripts for unconditional assertions over the affected paths, then grep the suites for fixtures that bootstrap the now-changed default and assert a whole-script exit code. In this case check-runtime-file-tracking.sh's Check C (durable provenance is never ignored) and test-init-specs.sh Case 6 (fresh fixture, no root .gitignore, commit specs/, assert exit 0) were both latent breaks that the research report had listed only as an optional follow-on. Fold them into the same plan rather than deferring -- a deferred posture-awareness gap ships a known-red suite.
